intro.h2: Refinish the tub you have, skip the tear-out
paragraphs: Good Work Construction Corp's refinishing division handles bathtub refinishing in Pennsauken, NJ. If your tub is chipping, stained or a color nobody has wanted since the seventies, replacing it means demolition, plumbing and tile work. Refinishing it in place gives you a smooth, glossy surface without tearing anything out.

One customer was about to buy a new tub and is glad he went this route, because his tub looks brand new. Another had a master bath tub that had been chipping and getting worse for years. She sent Francisco photos, had a quote the same day and an appointment that same week.

items.name: Bathtub refinishing
items.blurb: Chips, worn spots and rough patches in an old tub get repaired and coated with a fresh, glossy finish. The pair of photos shown here is a real job: a tub with a long trail of chipped finish below the drain, then the same tub finished in clean white.

image.alt: Before and after of a bathtub: chipped, peeling finish below the drain on the left and a smooth glossy white finish on the right

items.name: Shower stall refinishing
items.blurb: Molded shower stalls dull and stain over time. We bring back a bright, even surface across the walls, ledges and built-in seat, working around the existing fixtures so you can keep your valve, grab bar and door.

image.alt: White shower stall with a built-in corner seat, chrome grab bar and lever valve

items.name: Dated color tubs
items.blurb: Yellow, pink, avocado or almond tubs can be refinished instead of replaced. The yellow tub here is taped off and ready, with paper and painter's tape covering the walls and floor around it so nothing else in the room gets touched.

image.alt: Yellow bathtub masked off with kraft paper and blue painter's tape on the surrounding walls and floor, ready for refinishing

items.title: Fast answers
items.text: One customer reached out on Facebook Messenger and heard back within ten minutes. Francisco asked for photos, sent a quote and set the appointment for that same week.

items.title: No overspray
items.text: Customers notice the prep. One says Francisco taped off the whole bathroom so there was no overspray anywhere outside the tub.

items.title: On time, and focused
items.text: Punctuality is the most common topic in our reviews. On one job Francisco arrived on time and worked the entire visit without a break until the tub was done.

items.title: Every question answered
items.text: A homeowner describes Francisco as patient: he took the time to explain the refinishing process in detail and answered each and every question she had.

about.text: Good Work Construction Corp runs this refinishing division out of Pennsauken, NJ, and Francisco is the person you will meet. Customers first found him through before and after photos of tubs he had refinished, and the reviews read much the same: professional, prompt and clear about the process. He tapes off the room, protects the floor, does the work in one visit and leaves the tub looking new, so you skip the cost and disruption of a full replacement. Reach us Monday through Saturday starting at 8 AM.
about.owner_role: Named in every review as the person who does the refinishing; full name and title to confirm

steps.title: Send a few photos
steps.text: Call or message us and send pictures of your tub or shower. Francisco uses them to understand the condition and the job.

steps.title: Get your quote
steps.text: We send a quote based on your photos, and when it works for you we set an appointment, often within the same week.

steps.title: Tape off the room
steps.text: On the day, we arrive on time and mask the walls, floor and fixtures so there is no overspray in your bathroom.

steps.title: Repair and refinish
steps.text: Chips and worn areas are repaired, then the new finish goes on. We explain each step and answer your questions as we go.

steps.title: Enjoy a like-new tub
steps.text: We remove the masking and leave you with a tub or shower that customers describe as looking brand new.

items.name: Marjorie M.
items.text: Our master bath tub was in really bad condition. It started chipping and got worse over the last few years. I found Francisco through Facebook marketplace. He had posted some before and after pictures of tubs he had refinished. I read his reviews and decided to reach out via FB Messenger. He responded within ten minutes and asked me to send pictures. He provided a quote and we were able to set up an appointment that same week. The day of the job, he arrived on time. He worked the entire time without a break and did an amazing job. We could not be happier with the results. I would highly recommend this company. He did excellent work.

items.name: Zachary M.
items.text: Francisco was very professional in every aspect of the job. He taped off the whole bathroom so there was no overspray. He showed up on time and had great communication. I was going to get a new tub but glad I decided to go this route instead as the tub looks brand new. I highly recommend Francisco!

items.name: Sharon D.
items.text: Francisco was extremely professional, prompt, patient and took the time to explain the process in detail. He answered each and every question I had. My tub looks brand new!

service_area.h2: Bathtub refinishing in Pennsauken, NJ and nearby
service_area.text: Our refinishing division is listed on 41st St in Pennsauken, NJ. Google does not show a wider service area for us yet, so the simplest way to find out if we can reach your home is to call (609) 325-8843 or send a message with your town and a couple of photos of the tub or shower. We will tell you right away.

items.q: Is refinishing worth it instead of replacing my tub?
items.a: For many tubs, yes. One customer planned to buy a new tub and was glad he chose refinishing instead, because his tub looks brand new. Refinishing skips the demolition, plumbing and tile repair that come with pulling out a tub. Send photos and we will tell you honestly which way makes sense.

items.q: Can you fix a tub that is chipping?
items.a: Yes. One master bath tub had been chipping and getting worse over several years before the homeowner called us, and she says she could not be happier with the results. The before and after photos on this page show another chipped tub we refinished.

items.q: Will the spray get on the rest of my bathroom?
items.a: No. We tape off the whole bathroom before any refinishing starts, covering the walls, floor and fixtures with paper and painter's tape. A customer specifically mentions that there was no overspray after his job was finished, which is the whole point of the masking we do.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Send us a few pictures of your tub or shower stall. On one job Francisco replied within ten minutes, asked for photos, sent a quote and booked the appointment for that same week. You can call (609) 325-8843 or email goodworkconstructioncorp@gmail.com.

Google lists us as open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 8 PM and on Saturdays from 8 AM. We are closed on Sunday. Evening hours make it easier to call after work and talk through your tub or shower with Francisco.

final_cta.h2: Make your tub look brand new
final_cta.text: Send Francisco a few photos and get a quote, often the same day.
